analyst_view.overall: SC Cambuur (8th, 18 pts) host Sparta Rotterdam (14th, 12 pts) on Saturday night at the Kooi Stadion; the numbers make Cambuur favourites in a high-scoring game, about 4.4 goals. Sparta have lost three of their last four, most recently 1-5 at home to AZ on 22 November, when captain Bruno Martins Indi was sent off for a second yellow with about 15 minutes left; he misses this game and the numbers already count it. Sparta have conceded 34 goals in 13 games, Cambuur have scored 28 and conceded 29. Martin van den Kerkhof is listed as referee on Sporza; the numbers do not have a referee for this game and I found no reliable recent card record for him. News on both squads was thin: I found no other injuries reported.

goals.text: The numbers say 4.4 goals, 2.7 for Cambuur, already raised for Cambuur's 18 goals in their last six and for Martins Indi's absence in Sparta's defence (+6.2% on Cambuur's side). Sparta's heavy defeat to AZ fits what the numbers already see, and I found no other team news, so I stay at 4.4.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.5 corners, fairly evenly split (4.5 for Cambuur, 5.0 for Sparta). Nothing I found on lineups or style changes this, so I stay at about 9.5.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards, already raised for Sparta's busy recent bookings (+11.7%), which include Martins Indi's two yellows against AZ. The referee is listed as Martin van den Kerkhof, but I could not find a reliable recent card record, so I do not move for him and stay at 4.1.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.8 shots, with small momentum changes already in (+3.1% for Cambuur, -4.8% for Sparta). Without team news pointing anywhere, I stay at about 28.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.3 shots on target, already raised for Cambuur's sharp recent shooting (39 on target in six, +11.8%) against a Sparta defence that has leaked chances. Nothing new to add, so I stay at 11.3.
